stories.title: Even in loss, Skubal 'plenty good' in L.A. debut
stories.summary: Two-time Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal didn't have his best stuff in his Los Angeles debut Tuesday, landing just 51 strikes on 85 pitches, but, at the same time, the Dodgers offered little run support as they dropped a 5-1 outing to the Chicago Cubs.

stories.title: Sources: Bears give RT Wright historic extension
stories.summary: The Bears and star right tackle Darnell Wright reached agreement Tuesday on a historic four-year, $116 million extension that includes $93M guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Yanks' Lombard homers in debut, joining brother
stories.summary: George Lombard Jr. became the third-youngest Yankee to homer in his first game, and he did it on a night when his little brother also went deep in his own professional debut.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons' Walker feared to have torn ACL
stories.summary: Falcons edge rusher Jalon Walker is feared to have torn his ACL, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Steve Wyche.

stories.title: Doncic's ex-fiancée pulls child support petition
stories.summary: Luka Doncic's ex-fiancée Anamaria Goltes is withdrawing her petition seeking child support and attorney fees from the Lakers star.
